Bundled AI restores luminance at 3×. Other output sizes use local resampling.
Edge-aware local filters. Dedicated learned denoise and deblur models are a technical dependency.
Choose only the restoration this photo needs. All models run locally and are prepared from the installed app on first use.
A conservative local detector selects likely scratches, then LaMa fills only those regions. Review important photos after processing.
YuNet detects faces and a SwinIR restoration model rebuilds face-region detail. Generated detail may differ from the person or the historic scene.
DDColor predicts color locally while the original lightness and transparency are preserved. Predicted colors are not historically verified.
Draw over missing or damaged areas. LaMa reconstructs only the selected mask; unselected pixels stay unchanged.

Bundled models run offline and initialize independently. Super-resolution restores luminance at 3×; other output sizes use local resampling. Restoration can generate plausible detail and color, so review important photos.
The installed model catalog and all archived license files are listed below. Local inference uses Microsoft ONNX Runtime under the MIT license. No runtime download occurs.
The app has no Internet permission, account, analytics or cloud processing. Private projects are excluded from backups. Sharing only happens when you choose it.
